title: An Alon-Boppana Bound for the Non-Backtracking Operator
summary: For any fixed $k$, we prove a lower bound on the $k$th largest modulus of an eigenvalue of the non-backtracking matrix $B$. Specifically, consider any deterministic or random family of graphs that converges locally to the unimodular Galton-Watson tree with root degree distribution $D$, and set $κ:=\mathbb E[D(D-1)]/\mathbb E[D]$. Given $κ>1$ and an exponential-moment bound on the empirical degree distributions, we show that $|λ_k(B)|\geq\sqrtκ-o_N(1)$, where $N$ is the number of vertices.
